title: English teacher
description:
Nova oportunidade para English teacher em guaíba. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!You be your own boss and set your own scheduleWork from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.Minimum Requirements:Portuguese as a first language.C1 or C2 Level English SpeakerUniversity degree in English Teaching or related area.One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.Must pass a criminal background check.Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

title: People business partner
description:
Confira a vaga para People business partner em agudos. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

This role is part of thePeople Successarea and acts as a strategic partner to leaders and teams, ensuring a high-impact, culture-aligned employee experience throughout the full journey. The role owns end-to-end onboarding and offboarding processes, provides ongoing support and coaching to organizational leaders, and leads initiatives related to culture, benefits, and corporate social responsibility (CSR), always with a continuous improvement and scalability mindset.What You'll Do:Own and lead end-to-end onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring a smooth, consistent, and culture-aligned employee experience.Act as a strategic partner to leaders, providing ongoing guidance, coaching, and support on team health, performance, engagement, and complex people situations.Serve as a trusted point of contact for employees and managers, delivering high-quality internal client support with a strong service mindset.Drive and execute culture and engagement initiatives that strengthen Qubika’s values and employee experience across teams.Identify improvement opportunities through feedback and data, and implement scalable solutions to enhance People processes and the overall employee lifecycle.What we expect from you:Experience working for Brazilian companies in Brazil. SP/Curtiva Preferred4+ years of experience in HRBP/People Partner/HR Generalist roles with strong leadership exposurewithin tech companies.Bachelor’s degree in Psychology, Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field; advanced degree is a plus.Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal). Fluent Spanish nice to have.Experience working in dynamic, multicultural and/or distributed environments is a plus.Previous experience with Workday is a plus.Soft SkillsClear, empathetic, and assertive communication.Strong teamwork and collaboration skills.Strategic mindset with strong execution.Autonomy, prioritization, and multi-stakeholder management.Analytical thinking and Data-driven approach to People practices.What we offer:Exciting and innovative projects for disruptive start-ups and world-class companies.A creative working environment with a positive and collaborative atmosphere within an open-minded community.A senior team that offers mentorship opportunities to help you excel in your career.Enjoy a range of benefits at Qubika, including flexible work hours, ongoing skill development, language lessons, travel opportunities, engaging activities, expert talks, and more.

title: Secretaria clinica odontológica
description:
Confira a vaga para Secretaria clinica odontológica em arapongas. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Descrição da Empresa: Clinica Odontológica de médio porte localizado na Área Octogonal, Brasília-DF.Descrição do CargoEstamos à procura de uma Secretaria Clínica Odontológica para atuar em nossa equipe em Brasília, Distrito Federal. Este cargo requer o gerenciamento de tarefas administrativas relacionadas ao funcionamento diário da clínica, como o agendamento de consultas, organização de documentos e atendimento a pacientes. Outras responsabilidades incluem suporte direto à equipe odontológica, garantindo um ambiente organizado e eficiente. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e requer presença no local.QualificaçõesHabilidades Administrativas:Experiência em tarefas administrativas e organizacionais, como gestão de documentos e controle de agenda.Comunicação:Boa habilidade verbal e escrita, para interagir de forma clara e cortês com pacientes e a equipe da clínica.Atendimento ao Cliente:Experiência com atendimento ao público, garantindo uma experiência excepcional e demonstrando empatia e profissionalismo.Suporte Administrativo:Conhecimento em assistência administrativa e secretarial para dar suporte ao time odontológico nas rotinas da clínica.Requisitos adicionais, como cursos voltados à área odontológica, serão considerados diferenciais.

Company Introduction Next Day AI is a privately held company specializing in applying artificial intelligence (AI) engineering and creative innovation in B2 C entertainment products. Our mission is to leverage the power of Large Language Models (LLM) and generative AI (Gen AI) to create innovative consumer products that push the boundaries of entertainment and companionship. With over 35 millions+ messages per day and millions of monthly visitors, our products are revolutionizing the way people interact with AI. This is a unique opportunity to participate and make a real difference in a company actively working to shape the future of AI applications for consumers. Job Description We're looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer who can own and drive the frontend experience across our web and mobile products. We need someone who sees problems, proposes solutions, and ships them. You'll be working across a modern React (web) and React Native (mobile) codebase, building features used by millions of users every day. You'll care deeply about code quality, maintainability, and performance - and you'll champion the use of AI-assisted and agentic coding tools to move faster without sacrificing standards. You're the kind of engineer who treats AI coding assistants as a force multiplier, not a crutch, and you're always looking for ways to improve code quality and performance with these tools. This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role. You'll collaborate closely with product, design, backend engineers, and QA - but at the end of the day, you'll own your domain and be trusted to make the right calls. What You'll Do Build, ship, and maintain high-quality features across our React web application and React Native mobile app, working across the full frontend surface area. Take ownership of major frontend initiatives end-to-end - from technical design through implementation, testing, and deployment - without needing hand-holding. Write clean, well-tested, maintainable Type Script code that other engineers can confidently build on. Champion code quality standards, review PRs thoroughly, and help to raise the bar for the whole team. Actively leverage AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Git Hub Copilot, or similar) and agentic workflows to accelerate development. Advocate for and help the team adopt best practices around AI-augmented engineering. Collaborate with Product, Design, and QA to translate requirements into elegant, performant user experiences. Push back when something doesn't make sense and propose better alternatives. Improve our frontend architecture, patterns, and tooling. Identify technical debt and address it proactively - you don't wait for permission to make things better. Contribute to our shared business logic and component libraries, ensuring consistency across web and mobile platforms. Mentor and support other engineers through code reviews, pairing sessions, and knowledge sharing. Lead by example.  What We're Looking For 5+ years of professional frontend engineering experience with a strong track record of shipping production software at scale. Deep expertise in React and the modern React ecosystem (hooks, context, routing, state management). You don't just use React - you understand it. Solid experience with React Native or strong willingness to ramp up quickly. We need someone comfortable building across both web and mobile. Advanced Type Script proficiency. You write typed code by default and understand how to use the type system to prevent bugs and improve developer experience. A genuine passion for clean, maintainable code. You care about naming things well, keeping components focused, writing meaningful tests, and leaving code better than you found it. Demonstrated experience with AI-assisted development tools and a clear point of view on how to use them effectively. You're a champion of agentic coding workflows and can show how you've used them to ship faster. Self-directed and proactive. You take initiative, own your work fully, and don't need to be managed closely. You see what needs doing and do it. Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset. You can articulate technical decisions clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, startup-like environment where priorities shift and ambiguity is the norm.  Nice to have Familiarity with our tech stack: React 18, React Native, Type Script, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Redux Toolkit, Vitest, React Testing Library, Git Hub Actions, Yarn 4 Experience with real-time features (Socket. Io, Web Sockets) and streaming interfaces Experience building and consuming shared component libraries or design systems Familiarity with feature flag systems (Growth Book or similar) and progressive rollout strategies Background in B2 C consumer products with high traffic and millions of daily active users Experience with PWA architecture, service workers, and offline-first patterns Familiarity with the Atlassian suite (Jira, Confluence) Interest or experience in AI/LLM products and conversational interfaces  Why join us? Real 100% remote work (we don't have physical offices to go to "once per week") Flex-time / Manage your schedule Policy (we are looking for teamwork and results, not hours) Unlimited Vacations Policy Competitive salary and benefits package. A dynamic and supportive work environment.  If you're passionate about AI and innovation and want to be at the forefront of the conversational AI revolution and join a team on the first few years of a great journey, apply today! We might have a seat for you on our rocketship!

We're looking for a hardworking and passionate Senior Software Engineer to join Wildlife's Live Games Tech Team in São Paulo. At Wildlife, senior engineers don't just execute - they own. Our Live Games Tech Team operates with end-to-end accountability across some of our most-played titles, with millions of daily active players worldwide. You'll make architectural decisions, lead technical initiatives, define how the team operates in production, and mentor the engineers around you - all without layers of approval slowing you down. The scope is large. The autonomy is real. And the scale means your decisions have immediate, measurable impact on a product that millions of people play every day. Our stack spans Unity/C# on the client, Go on the backend, and AWS with Kubernetes for infrastructure. WHAT YOU'LL DO Lead the design and implementation of complex features across mobile client and backend services, making sound architectural trade-offs. Own technical decisions for your area - architecture, performance, scalability, long-term maintainability - and be accountable for the outcomes. Ship new versions to production and take full ownership of post-release behavior: monitoring, reading signals, and iterating fast. Define and evolve the team's observability practices: SLIs, alerting, dashboards, and incident response processes. Proactively identify and drive improvements across the codebase: performance, scalability, and engineering quality. Mentor and coach more junior engineers through code reviews, technical discussions, and pair programming. Shape the technical direction of features in collaboration with product and design from their earliest stages. Translate technical complexity into clear, timely communication for the team and stakeholders.  WHAT YOU'LL NEED Solid experience as a software developer, with production systems at scale. Strong background in software architecture and system design for production environments. Experience with monitoring, observability, and incident response in live systems. Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives and mentor junior engineers. Working proficiency in English.  Nice to have Experience with Unity/C# for mobile development. Experience with Go and Kubernetes-based backend systems. Experience with AWS infrastructure. Background in the gaming industry or other high-traffic consumer products.  MORE ABOUT YOU You've shipped things that live in production, and you understand what real ownership means. You make architectural decisions with confidence - and you can explain the 'why' to engineers, product, and leadership without losing the room. You raise the technical bar for the people around you, not as overhead, but as a natural consequence of how you work. You think in systems. You don't wait for the perfect spec. And when something breaks in production, you're the one people want to have already been thinking about it. ABOUT WILDLIFE Wildlife is one of the leading mobile game developers and publishers in the world. We have released more than 60 titles, reaching billions of people around the globe. Here, we create and maintain games that will excite, intrigue, and engage our players for years to come! We do not discriminate based upon race, colour, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We're committed to providing accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process.

Ecorobotix SA. creates innovative robotic solutions that reduce the negative ecological impact of modern agriculture. We have developed an AI-based ultra-high precision spot spraying technology that drastically reduces the amount of chemicals used in crop fields while keeping costs competitive. The technology is currently deployed on our tractor towed ARA machine. By joining our talented and dynamic team, you will contribute to a more sustainable, environment-friendly agriculture in an innovative scale-up at the cutting edge of technology. We are a revolutionary organization with a great work environment that supports creativity through self-motivation.To pursue our growth in Brazil, we are hiring an experienced entrepreneurial mind based in Santa Catarina State for an:Area Sales ManagerGeneral objective of the roleAs an Area Sales Manager of the Ecorobotix SA. Team, you will be responsible for managing and expanding the sales of agricultural machinery within a designated region. The role involves overseeing existing dealer relationships, optimizing dealer performance, and driving new business opportunities by identifying future dealers and customers as well as driving revenue growth. The Area Sales Manager will work closely with dealers to ensure product availability, support, and training, ensuring the company’s agricultural machinery is effectively marketed and sold. This position requires a leader with a deep understanding of market dynamics, strong leadership skills, and the ability to foster a results-oriented sales culture within the region.Reporting lines and interactionsThis role reports directly to the Commercial Director. Internally, you will closely collaborate with other members of the Sales team and other teams of Ecorobotix. Externally, you will interact with dealers, farmers, partners, associations, trade shows, Agronomists, and CCA’s.A day in the life of an Area Sales ManagerThe Area Sales Manager will travel across the designated territory to visit key accounts, meet new prospects, and support dealer partners. Whether you're pulling into a grower's yard or a dealership lot, you're the face of a cutting-edge ag-tech company that's reshaping the future of precision spraying.You will showcase how our high-precision sprayer delivers real ROI: less chemical waste, more targeted application, and better yields. You walk growers through the technology— highlighting features like variable rate spraying and intelligent targeting—while grounding every conversation in real-world impact. You sit down and dig into the potential customer’s specific challenges and help them see how the product fits into their operation. You're not just selling equipment; you're helping solve problems.“You’re part field representative, part storyteller, part strategist. You’re a trusted advisor selling value, not just hardware.”Key ResponsibilitiesIdentify and prospect new customers across Brazil, managing all communication and driving the sales process through to contract signature.Engage with customers to understand their needs and provide tailored solutions, ensuring strong order generation and relationship development.Assess customer solvency, share pricing information, negotiate terms, and suggest improvements to optimize pricing strategies.Provide training and ongoing support to partners, while identifying opportunities for expanding and strengthening the partner network.Actively participate in industry fairs, customer demos, and events to increase visibility and drive engagement in the region.Foster collaboration and support within the distributor network to drive sales and enhance product reach.Create compelling content in collaboration with the marketing team to support campaigns and enhance brand presence.QualificationsMaster’s degree in Sales and/or Agronomy, or related field.10+ years of experience in sales and hands-on experience in agriculture, ag-tech, or precision equipment.Willingness to travel domestically in Brazil.Must-HaveExperience in Ag-tech or chemical distribution.Knowledge in Agronomy related to weeding in field crops.Your AssetsExcellent communication and leadership skills, willingness to build relationships with customers.Exceptional written and verbal presentation skills, with clear & consistent communication.High degree of independence, reliability, and spirit of initiative.Driven individual with systematic, goal-oriented working methods.Computer skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, Power Point, and CRM tools.Strong organizational and multi-tasking skillsTeam-player

title: Técnico em automação
description:
Confira a vaga para Técnico em automação em arujá. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

A Roeslein Brasil abrange mais de 9.000 metros quadrados e é responsável pela fabricação de uma série de equipamentos especializados, incluindo transportadores, sistemas de biogás, skids de petróleo e gás e soluções industriais modulares. A equipe de São Paulo possui expertise profissional em uma ampla gama de serviços avançados de manufatura, incluindo corte a laser, prensagem, soldagem e sistemas de pintura eletrostática. Se você se identifica com o nosso ethos – ser sempre humilde, estar sempre disposto e feliz – confira a vaga disponível abaixo e venha fazer parte da nossa equipe! Atuação: 100% Presencial Região de Atuação: Arujá/SP Horário de Trabalho: Segunda à quinta-feira das 07h às 17h (com 1h para refeição) e sexta-feira das 07h às 16h (com 1h para refeição) Modelo de Trabalho: CLT RESUMO DA POSIÇÃO: Será responsável por executar atividades de instalação, integração, testes e comissionamento de sistemas de automação industrial. Atuará na montagem e interligação de painéis de controle, instalação de dispositivos de campo, conexão de CLPs, remotas e IHMs, além da realização de testes funcionais, start-up de máquinas e suporte ao comissionamento elétrico e de software. O profissional atuará garantindo a correta implementação dos sistemas de automação em máquinas, equipamentos e linhas de produção industriais, assegurando conformidade com projetos elétricos, padrões técnicos, normas de segurança e requisitos de qualidade da empresa. DEVERES E RESPONSABILIDADES ESSENCIAIS: Realizar instalação e interligação de painéis elétricos e painéis de automação conforme diagramas e especificações técnicas. Efetuar passagem, identificação, organização e terminação de cabos de potência, controle e comunicação. Instalar infraestrutura elétrica: cable trays, eletrocalhas, leitos, dutos, conduítes e acessórios. Executar conexão de CLPs, remotas de I/O, IHMs, inversores de frequência, sensores, atuadores e demais dispositivos de automação. Efetuar testes de I/O (entrada e saída) e validação de sinais de campo. Realizar testes funcionais em sistemas de automação e equipamentos industriais. Executar parametrização de CLPs, inversores de frequência e dispositivos inteligentes. Realizar diagnósticos e solução de falhas elétricas e de automação. Executar ajustes e modificações em programas de CLP e interfaces HMI quando necessário. Participar de atividades de start-up de máquinas e linhas de produção. Interpretar diagramas elétricos, listas de I/O, arquiteturas de rede industrial e documentação técnica de automação. Realizar integração de sistemas de automação e comunicação industrial. Atualizar documentação técnica e registrar ajustes realizados durante testes e comissionamento (" Asbuilt"). Atuar em conjunto com a equipe de engenharia durante fases de testes, comissionamento e start-up. Cumprir padrões de qualidade, normas técnicas e requisitos de segurança (NR-10, NR-12 e normas aplicáveis). Realizar atividades de instalação e suporte técnico em campo quando necessário.  CONHECIMENTO / HABILIDADE / EDUCAÇÃO / EXPERIÊNCIA: Curso Técnico em Automação Industrial, Eletrotécnica, Mecatrônica ou áreas relacionadas. Desejável: 5 (cinco) anos de experiência prática em automação industrial, instalação de sistemas de controle ou comissionamento de equipamentos industriais, testes de sinais de campo, leitura de diagramas elétricos e integração de dispositivos de automação.  OUTROS ATRIBUTOS DESEJÁVEIS: Experiência com CLPs Siemens e/ou Rockwell / Allen-Bradley. Conhecimento em redes industriais como Profinet e Ether Net/IP. Experiência em indústria de latas de alumínio será considerada um diferencial. Experiência em automação de transportadores será considerada um diferencial. Experiência com sistemas de tratamento de biogás será considerada um diferencial.  BENEFÍCIOS Na Roeslein, investimos no sucesso e no bem-estar dos nossos colaboradores. Abaixo estão os benefícios oferecidos: Assistência médica (cobertura apartamento) e odontológica Seguro de Vida Vale refeição/alimentação (R$60,00 por dia útil) Incentivos para educação, com reembolsos para cursos de idiomas, cursos técnicos, graduações e especializações Incentivos para saúde física, com totalpass, reembolsos anuais de academia e reembolsos por corridas de ruas Programa de bônus Gratificação em viagens corporativas

Desde que começamos, lá em 1985, o mundo mudou bastante. A forma como as pessoas vivem, como elas se deslocam, como elas usam seu tempo e como interagem umas com as outras. E tudo isso também transformou a nossa forma de enxergar o mercado — deixando de ser padronizado para se tornar cada vez mais personalizado. Se cada pessoa tem sua individualidade, por que os projetos devem ser iguais? Esse olhar atento para as pessoas é o que transforma a SKR em uma empresa reconhecida por sua inovação. Desenvolvemos parcerias sólidas, como a Joint Venture com a Incorporadora Cyrela (2007), além de projetos com arquitetos renomados e fundos de investimento como CPPIB e SPX. Nos orgulhamos da referência que nos tornamos e seguimos com o propósito que definimos desde o início: entregar mais do que unidades — entregar novas formas de viver. O que buscamos: Estamos em fase de crescimento e buscamos um(a) Analista de Orçamentos para integrar o nosso time! Você será responsável por: Analisar projetos e realizar levantamentos quantitativos com base em projetos em diversas etapas de desenvolvimento; Elaborar estimativas de custo e orçamentos de obra, desde o lançamento até o orçamento executivo para início de execução; Analisar composições de custo unitário e curva ABC de insumos e serviços; Solicitar cotações a fornecedores e equalizar propostas, visando obter o melhor custo-benefício; Negociar com fornecedores e prestadores de serviços, buscando as melhores condições de preço, qualidade e prazo; Realizar estudos de custo alternativos ao escopo proposto, identificando oportunidades de redução; Acompanhar o projeto durante seu desenvolvimento, garantindo entendimento do ciclo e manutenção dos critérios de levantamento quantitativo; Compor banco dedados com informações de orçamentos e obras, contribuindo para criação e análise de indicadores; Elaborar documentos auxiliares ao orçamento, como considerações, exclusões, apresentações e demais materiais necessários; Apoiar a obra quanto a dúvidas e esclarecimentos relacionados aos orçamentos elaborados; Realizar o lançamento e a gestão do orçamento no sistema (Sienge); Garantir o cumprimento dos prazos de entrega e das metas estabelecidas pela área. Over the past 8 years, we've built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we're growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. You write expressive, readable, and maintainable code and hold yourself and others to a high standard through thoughtful code reviews. You're curious about Io T, Wi Fi, and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations. You're energized by working on a small team where your decisions carry real weight. Take ownership of large, complex projects: from scoping and architecture through to delivery in close collaboration with the CTO. Identify and address performance bottlenecks, technical debt, and architectural weaknesses proactively. Build and maintain robust API integrations with 3rd party software providers. Lead by example in pull request culture; writing clear descriptions, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team. Contribute to engineering standards, tooling decisions, and best practices as a senior voice on the team.  Why Work at Stay Fi?You'll work directly with the CTO and CEO on mission-critical projects with real ownership and autonomy. Your experience and judgment will directly shape the technical direction of the product. You'll have an outsized impact both within our company and across the vacation rental industry in a way that's rarely possible at larger organizations. As you continue to help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate. You'll gain visibility into the full lifecycle of a sustainable, founder-led business well beyond just writing code.

title: Technical product owner
description:
Nova oportunidade para Technical product owner em americana. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

ABOUT US  Syniti  , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.  Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.  Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.  Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.  THE ROLE   We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven  Technical Product Owner  to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4 HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.  What You’ll Do   Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.  Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.  UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.  Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.  Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.  Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.    WHAT IT TAKES   The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).  The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.  The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.  The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.  The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.  The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.    Key Skills    Visionary Leadership:  Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.   Advanced Governance Concepts:  Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.   AI/ML Application:  Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.   Visual Communication:  Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.   Technical Storyboarding:  Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.   Relationship Orchestration:  Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.  Drive for Results:  Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.    Be fully aligned with our core values:  Think Big  - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.  Be Curious  - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.  Take Action  - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.  Stronger Together  - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.  By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.   WHAT WE OFFER   Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.  Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.  Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.  Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.  Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.  An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.    OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION  At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.  We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

Nova oportunidade para Associate ii, pharmacovigilance - brazil - remote em itapecerica da serra. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

What the Associate II, Pharmacovigilance does at Worldwide  Responsible for the collection, processing, evaluation and reporting of incoming Serious Adverse Event (SAE) data according to applicable regulatory guidelines/requirements, Worldwide Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and project specific instructions. Serves as Lead PV Associate on moderate to large sized studies that are moderate to complex in scope of work with moderate support from senior staff. title: English teacher
description:
Nova oportunidade para English teacher em quatro barras. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.  If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.  What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?  You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.  If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.  When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that! In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:   Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule  Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).  Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.    Minimum Requirements:   Portuguese as a first language.  C1 or C2 Level English Speaker  University degree in English Teaching or related area.  One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.  Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.  Must pass a criminal background check.  Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.    Who we are:   Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Gerente de produção
description:
Nova oportunidade para Gerente de produção em paraná. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Descrição da vaga: Somos uma indústria gráfica especializada em embalagens para o setor de confeitaria.  Estamos à procura de profissionais qualificados e que trabalham com foco na excelência.  Cargo: Gerente de Produção  ●Elaborar o cronograma de produção conforme pedidos e prazos de entrega.  ●Definir prioridades e ajustar o planejamento diante de imprevistos (falhas de máquina, atrasos de insumos etc.).  ●Garantir que os recursos (mão de obra, matéria-prima e máquinas) estejam disponíveis no momento certo.  ●Liderar operadores, auxiliares e encarregados, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho produtivo e seguro.  ●Monitorar indicadores de produtividade (OEE, refugo, retrabalho, tempo de setup).  ●Implementar melhorias contínuas nos processos produtivos.  ●Garantir que os produtos estejam dentro dos padrões técnicos e visuais exigidos.  ●Controlar entradas e saídas de matéria-prima e produtos acabados.  ●Garantir que o estoque esteja sempre atualizado e sem divergências.  ●Definir layout eficiente do estoque (endereçamento, identificação visual, FIFO/FEFO).  ●Supervisionar inventários periódicos e reconciliar diferenças  ●Trabalhar em conjunto com o setor de compras para prever necessidades de reposição.  ●Alimentar o planejamento de produção com informações reais de estoque.  ●Reduzir rupturas de materiais e excesso de itens parados.  ●Report direto ao CEO e dono da Empresa  ●Grandes possibilidades de crescimento rápido  Qualificações obrigatórias:  ●Profissional orientado à meta  ●Perfil analitico  ●Proatividade  ●Bom conhecimento com operações de Estoque  ●Formação em Engenharia de Produção, Administração ou áreas correlatas.  Qualificações desejáveis  ●Ter experiência com ERP Omie.  ●Experiência com gestão de time.  Salário: R$ 6.000,00 bônus mensal de até R$1.000 + bônus anual de até R$15.000 Regime: PJ  Local: Bairro Hauer, Curitiba  Horário: Segunda a Sexta das 8hs às 18hs. title: Web3 & al investment analyst
description:
Nova oportunidade para Web3 & al investment analyst em gravataí. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Web3 DXB  is a Dubai-based investment and research platform focused on identifying and scaling high-potential opportunities at the intersection of  blockchain, artificial intelligence, and next-generation digital infrastructure  . We combine deep market insight with an agile, thesis-driven approach to back transformative technologies shaping the future of finance and the internet.  As we expand our investment activities, we are looking for a highly analytical and forward-thinking  Web3 & AI Investment Analyst  to join our team. This is a  fully remote position (Poland-based) , offering direct exposure to early-stage deals, market research, and high-impact investment decisions across Web3 and AI.  This role is ideal for someone who lives at the edge of innovation — tracking narratives, identifying asymmetric opportunities, and translating complex trends into actionable investment insights.   What You’ll Be Doing  Conduct deep-dive research on Web3 and AI sectors, including protocols, startups, and emerging technologies.  Analyze market trends, narratives, and macro developments across crypto and AI ecosystems.  Evaluate investment opportunities, including token projects, early-stage startups, and infrastructure plays.  Build investment theses and present insights to internal stakeholders.  Monitor portfolio performance and track key metrics across projects.  Collaborate with internal teams on strategy, deal flow, and market positioning.  Stay ahead of industry developments, identifying early signals and high-potential opportunities.     What We’re Looking For  2–4+ years of experience in investment analysis, research, venture capital, or crypto/AI markets.  Strong understanding of blockchain, De Fi, tokenomics, and Web3 ecosystems.  Solid knowledge or strong interest in artificial intelligence and its investment landscape.  Exceptional analytical and research skills with the ability to synthesize complex information.  Experience evaluating startups, token models, or market opportunities.  Ability to think independently and form high-conviction investment views.  Fluent English with strong written communication skills.  High level of curiosity, ownership, and performance orientation.     Why Join Web3 DXB  Competitive compensation:  BRL 560,000 – 770,000 + performance-based bonuses.   Remote-first:  Fully remote (Poland-based) with flexible working hours.   Direct investment exposure:  Work on real deals and high-impact decisions.   High-growth environment:  Operate at the intersection of Web3 and AI — two of the fastest-growing sectors globally.   Meritocratic culture:  Your ideas and insights directly influence outcomes.  Long-term upside:  Be part of a team shaping the future of decentralized and intelligent systems.    If you’re passionate about  Web3, AI, and investing  , and want to operate where innovation meets capital, we’d love to connect.

title: Technical product owner
description:
Empresa está contratando Technical product owner em guaíba. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

ABOUT US  Syniti  , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.  Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.  Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.  Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.  THE ROLE   We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven  Technical Product Owner  to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4 HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.  What You’ll Do   Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.  Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.  UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.  Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.  Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.  Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.    WHAT IT TAKES   The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).  The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.  The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.  The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.  The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.  The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.    Key Skills    Visionary Leadership:  Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.   Advanced Governance Concepts:  Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.   AI/ML Application:  Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.   Visual Communication:  Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.   Technical Storyboarding:  Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.   Relationship Orchestration:  Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.  Drive for Results:  Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.    Be fully aligned with our core values:  Think Big  - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.  Be Curious  - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.  Take Action  - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.  Stronger Together  - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.  By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.   WHAT WE OFFER   Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.  Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.  Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.  Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.  Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.  An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.    OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION  At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.  We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

description:
Empresa está contratando Salesforce business system analyst em campina grande do sul. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Job Title: Salesforce Business Systems Analyst (BSA)  Location: LATAM   Duration: 6-12months   Job Summary:   We are looking for a  Salesforce Business Systems Analyst (BSA) with strong experience in gathering business requirements, translating them into functional specifications, and supporting Salesforce implementation and enhancements. The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to deliver scalable Salesforce solutions that support business processes.  Key Responsibilities:   ·Work with business stakeholders to  gather, analyze, and document business requirements  for Salesforce implementations and enhancements.  ·Translate business needs into  functional requirements, user stories, and process flows  .  ·Act as a  bridge between business teams and technical teams  to ensure accurate implementation of requirements.  ·Configure and support Salesforce features including  Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, workflows, validation rules, reports, and dashboards  .  ·Participate in  solution design discussions  and recommend best practices within the Salesforce ecosystem.  ·Support  UAT (User Acceptance Testing) by preparing test cases, coordinating with stakeholders, and ensuring requirements are met.  ·Assist in  data migration, integration requirements, and system documentation  .  ·Provide  production support and troubleshooting  for Salesforce issues.  ·Maintain clear documentation including  BRDs, FRDs, user stories, and process diagrams  .  ·Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive  continuous improvement and system optimization  .  Required Qualifications:   ·3–6 years of experience  as a Business Analyst with  Salesforce platform exposure  .  ·Strong understanding of  Salesforce Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud  .  ·Experience with  requirements gathering, documentation, and stakeholder management  .  ·Knowledge of  Agile/Scrum methodologies  .  ·Ability to create  user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications  .  ·Experience with  Salesforce reporting, dashboards, and basic configuration  .  ·Strong  analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills

title: Técnico de serviços em maritimo
description:
Confira a vaga para Técnico de serviços em maritimo em paranaguá. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Mackay Marine é uma empresa global de serviço eletrônicos marítimos com mais de 450 funcionários em 45 depósitos de serviços em 17 países, incluindo Américas, Europa, África e Ásia. Por mais de cinquenta (50) anos, a Mackay vendeu, instalou e atendeu equipamentos de navegação e comunicação a bordo de navios comerciais e navais, iates e embarcações de recreio. A Mackay garante o sucesso de nossos funcionários investindo em treinamento contínuo na fábrica e fornecendo todas as peças, suporte técnico e administrativo necessários. Também oferecemos salários competitivos, horas extras, benefícios e oportunidades de crescimento com base no mérito. A Mackay Marine Brasil atualmente tem vagas em nossas localidade do Paranagua Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo com experiência, habilidades e qualificações abaixo. Mackay se originou e está sediada nos EUA, é necessário ter proficiência em falar, ler e escrever em inglês.  Resumo do Trabalho de Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo:  Sob supervisão limitada, os Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo (MST) instalam, fazem manutenção e reparam equipamentos eletrônicos marítimos a bordo de navios comerciais e navais, iates e embarcações de recreio. Eles testam, ajustam e solucionam problemas de componentes, PCBs, subconjuntos e antenas, bem como carregam, atualizam e modificam o software. Os Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo utilizam seus conhecimentos de teoria e circuitos eletrônicos para resolver uma variedade de problemas técnicos, bem como para fazer uso inteligente de esquemas complexos, projetos e manuais para realizar tarefas com precisão. Após a conclusão de cada trabalho, o técnico redigirá e enviará um relatório de serviço detalhado.  Tipos de equipamentos atendidos:  • Radares  • ECDIS  • Satcoms  • Rádios HF e VHF  • GPS  • Girobússola  • Pilotos automáticos  • Sirenes  Qualificações do Técnico em Marítima:  • Mais de 3 anos como MST na indústria de transporte marítimo comercial.  • Um diploma universitário em engenharia ou certificações técnicas equivalentes.  • Proficiente em falar, ler e escrever em inglês.  • Forte conhecimento de teoria e aplicação de eletrônica.  • Licença de Operador de Rádio GMDSS preferencialmente.  • Fisicamente apto. O ambiente de trabalho geralmente envolve carregar 20 quilos, subir escadas/mastros, trabalhar em espaços confinados e exposição ao clima.  Os candidatos devem estar legalmente autorizados a trabalhar no Brasil.

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
Nova oportunidade para Landholder and reforestation delivery manager em colombo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Nature Co  Nature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.  Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.  We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.     Role and responsibilities   The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.  The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.  Primary roles and responsibilities include:   Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management   Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.  Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.  Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.  Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.    Eligibility, due diligence & agreements   Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).  Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation  Lead closure of contract signatures.  Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system   (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).  Reforestation delivery enablement   Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).  Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.  Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).  Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).    Stakeholder engagement and safeguards   Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).  Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.  Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.  Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.    Reporting   Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.  Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.    Teamwork and culture   Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.  Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.    Skills and attributes   To perform successfully in this role, you will have:  A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.  Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.  Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills  Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.  Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.  A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.  A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners  Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.  Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.  A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.    Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.   Location    Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia    Submission instructions   Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager  Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.  What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?  You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.  If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.  When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that! In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:   Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule  Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).  Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.    Minimum Requirements:   Portuguese as a first language.  C1 or C2 Level English Speaker  University degree in English Teaching or related area.  One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.  Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.  Must pass a criminal background check.  Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.    Who we are:   Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

About Us  Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.  Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.  As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.  Key Responsibilities:   Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.  Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.  Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.  Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;  Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral  Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels  Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures  Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements  Net-worth monitoring;  Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.  Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.  Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.  Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.  Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.    Requirements:   Legally resident in Brazil.  Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.  Demonstrated  independence from commercial functions  and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.   Strong knowledge of  Central Bank of Brazil  risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.   Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.  Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.  Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in  Portuguese and English  .   Must meet  fit and proper  standards with  no disqualifying factors  , including:   not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;  unblemished reputation;  knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;  technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.  not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
Confira a vaga para Landholder and reforestation delivery manager em blumenau. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Nature Co  Nature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.  Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.  We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.     Role and responsibilities   The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.  The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.  Primary roles and responsibilities include:   Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management   Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.  Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.  Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.  Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.    Eligibility, due diligence & agreements   Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).  Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation  Lead closure of contract signatures.  Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system   (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).  Reforestation delivery enablement   Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).  Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.  Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).  Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).    Stakeholder engagement and safeguards   Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).  Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.  Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.  Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.    Reporting   Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.  Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.    Teamwork and culture   Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.  Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.    Skills and attributes   To perform successfully in this role, you will have:  A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.  Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.  Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills  Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.  Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.  A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.  A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners  Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.  Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.  A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.    Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.   Location    Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia    Submission instructions   Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager  Submission deadline: 30 March 2026
